technical.summary: MCK shows solid bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but weak trend strength (ADX 18), overbought short-term oscillators, and narrow Bollinger Band bandwidth limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MCK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 69 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 1 purchase, 1 sale in small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis regime (372.16) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates highly unfavourable conditions; earnings in 69 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with MACD bullish crossover, Hull flip, and Supertrend confirmation provides solid technical structure in a fear-driven contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought short-term oscillators (RSI 65, Stoch 74.69), weak trend confirmation (ADX 18.12), crisis VIX regime (372.16), unfavourable macro (-3), and zero fundamental/smart money support create excessive risk for swing entry despite technical setup.
